name: What are the key design considerations for a functional and comfortable Junior ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the key design considerations for a functional and comfortable Junior ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Designing a functional Junior ADU requires careful planning to maximize limited space. Key considerations include the layout of the efficiency kitchen and bathroom, ensuring adequate natural light and ventilation, and integrating smart storage solutions. The design should also prioritize privacy and sound separation for both the JADU occupants and the main home. AKN Design Group focuses on customized renovations, tailoring the design to enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value, even within compact footprints.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key design considerations for a JADU include efficient kitchen/bathroom layouts, natural light, storage, and ensuring privacy for occupants.
